description: Liens fiches horaires et plans des lignes de transport en commun d’Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Liste des liens vers les fiches horaires et plans des lignes commerciales de transport en commun (train, RER, métro, tramway, bus et car) circulant en Île-de-France. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Métro, Train, Bus, RER, Tramway, Horaires. The portal shows 4,155 records. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
